name: directus-docker
title: Kılavuz Etkinlik — Directus 11 events directory
description: Directus 11 + Postgres 16 with an events/categories data model built via the REST API by an idempotent bootstrap script and versioned as a schema snapshot; public-policy read access for published events; static nginx frontend with city filter.

env.name: DIRECTUS_SECRET
env.description: Directus SECRET (token signing) – rotate for real use

env.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
env.description: First admin user, created by Directus on first boot

env.name: PUBLIC_URL
env.description: Public URL of the Directus API/admin

auth.description: Directus admin (e-mail/password → JWT via POST /auth/login; admin SPA at /admin). Anonymous requests use the built-in Public policy, which the bootstrap script grants read on categories and on events where status = published; writes and system collections return 403.

persistence: Named volumes db_data (Postgres), directus_uploads, directus_extensions. Data model versioned in snapshot/schema.yaml (bind-mounted at /directus/snapshot). Seed data inserted by scripts/bootstrap.sh when collections are empty.
notes: Docker-only. After `docker compose up -d` wait for GET /server/health = 200 (Directus creates its system tables and the admin user from ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD on first boot), then run scripts/bootstrap.sh once (idempotent; needs python3 on the host; honours DIRECTUS_URL). Alternative: `docker compose exec directus npx directus schema apply --yes /directus/snapshot/schema.yaml` first, then bootstrap.sh for permissions + seed. Frontend on 8111 is plain files from ./frontend served by nginx; if not on localhost, edit frontend/config.js (window.API_URL) and set PUBLIC_URL/CORS_ORIGIN. Postgres is internal only. Health returns 200 JSON.
